title: Nexus and Prime Relay Desk
summary: Presents late-game boss intel, Prime relay resolution, Nexus UI state, branch choice, and ending consequences as player-readable route state.
nextSteps: Scan Prime relays before choosing a branch.
Read boss intel and countermeasure notes before entering a finale route.
Use the Nexus UI state to confirm whether Restore, Destroy, or Control is active.
Resolve relay pages before presenting ending branches.
Check the late-game HoloMap state after each branch milestone.

panels.title: Prime Relay State
panels.body: Prime relays should show scan status, route risk, branch pressure, and the next required objective.

panels.title: Boss Intel
panels.body: Boss entries must name the threat, countermeasure, reward, and branch consequence before the fight.

panels.title: Ending Branch
panels.body: Restore, Destroy, and Control endings should present what changes in the world, HoloMap, and Codex after commitment.
